preconditions.description: Input S is a non-empty string with length between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == S[j] for i, j in zip(range(len(return_value)), range(len(return_value)-1, -1, -1)))
postconditions.description: The returned substring is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) >= len(p) for p in [S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if all(S[k] == S[l] for k, l in zip(range(i, j+1), range(j, i-1, -1)))]
postconditions.description: The returned substring is the longest possible palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: S.find(return_value) == min(S.find(p) for p in [S[i:j+1] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if all(S[k] == S[l] for k, l in zip(range(i, j+1), range(j, i-1, -1))) and len(p) == len(return_value)])
postconditions.description: In case of multiple longest palindromic substrings of the same maximum length, the one with the smallest starting index is returned.
